sentences.text: Heard Mr. B.P. Singh, learned counsel for the petitioner.

Also heard Mr.
S.S. Baghel, learned Govt. Advocate for the State/respondents No.1.
Heard on I.A. No. 01/2026, application for grant of interim relief.

Learned counsel for the petitioner submits the petitioner is husband of the complainant and the marriage was solemnized between them 12.12.2016 at Bhilai and a several matrimonial dispute/proceedings are filed by each other on the different places which are still pending.
Earlier the complainant/respondent No.2 filed a complaint at Bangalore against the petitioner and his entire family members relating to dowry in which closure report has been filed.

She had also made complaint to the bank, wherein it was found that there is no any financial irregularity committed by the petitioner and a minor penalty was imposed for change of form of the complainant without her consent.
But, in the FIR, the marriage, the earlier complaint made by respondent No.2 before the police and bank are completely suppressed by the respondent No.2.
The respondent No.2 wants to harass the petitioner by one way or by another way therefore, present FIR has been lodged with false allegations.

Considering submissions made by learned counsel for the petitioner, further considering that there are the matrimonial disputes between the parties, purely as an interim measure it is ordered that till the next date of hearing the petitioner shall not be arrested pursuant to the impugned FIR No.
